body:
This parameter let the developer choose to escape the facet values returned by Algolia. This feature is required to keep the independance of widgets, and provide some opt-in safety. It originated when starting to work on #2474 but didn't want to just fix it.

NB: I also updated the Helper to be able to implement this feature.

Fix #2474
